columns.name: RESOURCE_QUOTA_ID
columns.description: System generated ID of the resource quota record

columns.name: RESOURCE_QUOTA_NAME
columns.description: Name of the resource quota, which could be compute-resources, erp, crm-sales, hcm, etc.

columns.name: SCOPE
columns.description: Scope of the resource quota, which could be GLOBAL (namespace level) or GROUP (group or service level)

columns.name: REQUESTED_MEM_THRESHOLD_MB
columns.description: Memory quota for limiting batch jobs at creation time

columns.name: MAX_MEM_THRESHOLD_MB
columns.description: Memory quota for limiting the maximum memory usage by batch jobs

columns.name: REQUESTED_CPU_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Cpu quota for limiting batch jobs at creation time

columns.name: MAX_CPU_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Cpu quota for limiting the maximum cpu usage by batch jobs

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
